The '''Rebel uniform jacket''' was an insulated jacket worn by select members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] command staff on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The jacket, tan in [[Color/Legends|color]], featured red trim along both breast pockets, indicative of command authority. Rebel personnel to don the uniform jacket at Echo Base included [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] and [[Pharl McQuarrie/Legends|Pharl McQuarrie]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]].
